mechanism: Moxifloxacin can cause QT prolongation and rarely torsades de pointes; olmesartan may cause hypotension and hyperkalemia, which combined with fluoroquinolone-induced electrolyte disturbances increases arrhythmia risk.
action: Monitor blood pressure, electrolytes (especially potassium), and ECG if QT interval baseline is abnormal; ensure adequate hydration and renal function monitoring during concurrent use.
